delivery.fallbackPolicy: Use complete reducedMotion mappings when requested. Required assets must resolve; no generated visual art.

collision.boundsCoordinates: absolute source canvas pixels; subtract groundAnchor before world scaling
collision.reservation: Lifetime union of all allowed frames, follower fits and concurrent clip deltas; constant per body across types.
collision.touchRule: gap <= engine touchSlack along one axis AND intervals overlap on other axis

wave.note: Three quick synchronized beats of both existing stubby nubs, 106.3 degree sweep and constant 15px length. Right-hand props follow an inset shared grip: high 10px above stand, low at stand, upright at unit scale. Body, face, head and torso stay fixed. Eight entries / 16 fps = 0.5 s; no motion marks.

held.note: Quarter-degree lean and one-pixel lift protect the tight headwear reserve; no root scaling.

scheduler.note: Pick-up interrupts any pose by the next presentation frame; all held/drop presentation uses a resolved free position. No procedural hop, squash, held enlargement or pop overshoot.
